summary: The exact hashed sources have internally consistent deterministic numerical checks, but this is not a motion-quality experiment. Eq. 12 is an assumed fixed-mask inpainting realization, ASFO sampling/mirroring is absent, and some test labels and architecture claims exceed the evidence.

scope.claim_ceiling: deterministic implementation-level formula, shape, mask, and gradient consistency only

gt_provenance.details: No dataset ground truth or motion-quality reference is used or claimed. Expected values are seeded analytic/self-consistency unit-test values and are explicitly labeled non-performance checks.

score_normalization.details: No performance score is normalized against prediction statistics. Feature z-scoring and the Eq. 9 attention maximum are not evaluation-score normalization.

result_existence.details: verification.json, stdout_stderr.log, and exit_code.txt exist; exit code is zero; eight labels and reported fields agree; all five embedded Python hashes match; the independent static parameter count is 146169702.

dead_code.details: The real DistilBERT adapter and default full-size forward are untested. The gradient label overstates assertion coverage, and a README mirror-probability statement has no bounded implementation.

scope.details: The README correctly disclaims training/evaluation/full reproduction, but the item-by-item Eqs. 7-14 statement is broader than the implementation. Eq. 12 physical-prefix semantics and ASFO sampler/mirroring are absent.

evaluation_type.details: Schema-compatible synthetic_proxy only; it is not a synthetic motion-quality experiment and supplies no empirical performance evidence.

eq_7.qualification: x0 objective primitive only; author beta schedule is unknown and caller-supplied

eq_8.qualification: one-token reduced-model formula is tested; default multi-token/full-size path is not

eq_9.qualification: uses head-averaged PyTorch attention; pre/post-dropout semantics are under-specified

eq_10_11.qualification: arithmetic matches, but zero multipliers/noninteger rho_max need resolution and sampling/mirroring is absent

eq_12.qualification: paper-unspecified fixed-mask inpainting assumption; no GMT/simulation/MPJPE/PPO loop

eq_13_14.qualification: algebra matches; real-model null mask/bias semantics are untested and undocumented

undocumented_or_partly_documented_assump: head-averaged and dropout-affected attention used for Eq. 9

claims.claim: Eight deterministic numerical checks passed on the exact hashed Python sources.
The code contains paper-grounded primitives for Eqs. 7-11 and 13-14.
The implementation corresponds item by item to Eqs. 7-14.
The full stated architecture constructs without pretrained weights.
Every expert pool and gate receives finite nonzero gradients.
The artifacts reproduce generation quality, language alignment, physical executability, or full PhyGile.

required_corrections: Narrow README line 5 to selected Eq. 7-11 and 13-14 primitives plus an Eq. 12-inspired assumed inpainting sampler.
Implement or remove the ASFO mirroring claim; require integer rho_max and define/test whether repetition multipliers may be zero.
Rename or strengthen the gradient test so its label matches exact per-parameter and per-expert assertions.
Test the actual MotionDenoiser null/negative conditioning path, multi-token chunking, and validity-mask behavior.
Document remaining attention, AdaLN, bias, dropout, null-condition, and inpainting-noise assumptions.
Do not make motion-quality or full-reproduction claims until trained/data/simulation/evaluation evidence exists.
